stem.text: The figure shows part of a chart of nuclides where neutron number is plotted against proton number.
An unstable nuclide X decays by emitting an $\alpha$-particle.

stem.alt: Chart with neutron number on the vertical axis from 140 to 147 and proton number on the horizontal axis from 91 to 96, with points labelled A, B, C, X and D.

stem.text: Which nuclide is formed by the decay of nuclide X?
